_doc: Hand-authored pins for arms-up-arms-down (country barn dance, Suno). The tempo drifts 136 -> ~139 BPM, so the chart follows the tracked beat grid; times are seconds snapped to that grid. Chorus command times = consensus of MMS forced alignment + faster-whisper small/medium word starts on the demucs vocal stem (heavy instrument bleed: low confidence on several words; chorus 2 = chorus 1 + 104 beats in all three tools). 'Hey!'/'Ho!' shouts are left free as breathing room.

preview.why: chorus 1 from the gang shouts through the sweep (8 bars)

photos.why: beat 77: gang 'Hey! Hey! Hey!' right before chorus 1
beat 113: right after chorus 1's sweep, the fiddle solo kicks in
beat 173: review: replaces the clap at 1:15.924 (bar 43.4), last bar of the solo before the chorus 2 clap-along. Replaces the old 'Yee-haw' photo at 95.10 s, which was too hard to play out of
beat 237: strike a pose on the last downbeat before the two final hits (clap clap ending). Replaces the mid-solo photo (65.50 s), which would be < 15 s from the 75.98 s photo
